programs.title: That Thrifting Show with Lara Spencer
programs.desc: Lara Spencer doles out a dining room challenge in an English Cottage vs. Modern Glam faceoff. From travertine to bold stripes, they race to create high-end spaces in just two days--each with a very different vision.

programs.title: That Thrifting Show with Lara Spencer
programs.desc: Lara Spencer challenges two teams to thrift and transform a space into a swanky speakeasy, pitting Moroccan flair against Art Deco glamour as they hunt for standout pieces and reimagine secondhand finds into dramatic, high-style designs.

programs.title: Renovation Resort
programs.desc: The teams move onto the guest bedrooms, needing to transform two full spaces that must feel unique yet cohesive with the rest of their Lake House; these rooms must suit any type of guest, and maybe even outshine the primary! But as a blast from the past shakes up the challenge, the teams must get creative to adapt and impress; riding the highs of recent wins and reeling from tough losses, teams take bigger risks, and dig deep as time, energy and patience run thin in the final weeks.

programs.title: House Hunters International
programs.sub_title: A Whale of an Adventure in Hervey Bay, Australia
programs.desc: After leaving France for a post-college wilderness adventure, a young nature lover dives into adulthood in Hervey Bay, Australia; she's eager for her own independent space, but on her small budget, she quickly learns that housemates will be a necessity.

programs.title: House Hunters International
programs.sub_title: Leaving Work for Puerto Morelos, Mexico
programs.desc: After living his entire life in Washington, a man decides to sell his business and start anew in Puerto Morelos, Mexico. He's looking for a house that's large enough for visiting family, but with limited inventory, he may need to consider a condo.

programs.title: House Hunters International
programs.desc: A family leaves the Yukon Territory to pursue advanced education opportunities in Aberdeen, Scotland; they're looking for something near the city center that's walkable to schools, but finding the right place on their budget will be a challenge.
